verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an official MCP server (rudderstack-mcp) that works with Claude, Codex, Cursor, and VS Code Copilot, enabling natural-language debugging, transformation writing, and tracking plan review, and a runtime probe confirms a live hosted MCP endpoint at mcp.rudderstack.com with proper OAuth-protected initialization. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) hands-on validation of the MCP server's functionality beyond the probe check.
